system.description:
Requirements: You must have at least one tempered ur-stone worn against your skin

Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: Self

You spread jade energy through your skin, hardening it into a protective shell.

Until the start of your next turn, your Armor increases by +2.

If you are hit by an attack or damaging effect, you may negate the hit by ending this effect early, as the energy coating your skin shatters.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.ebg7jmHBDunanqeJ]{Jade Steel}
